spec.status: layout and gravity feasibility study; not installed or construction design
spec.authority: Owner permits floor-layout changes and prioritises simplicity, 27 October 2026
spec.groundAndFirstWallMaterial: 215 mm dense blockwork candidate; masonry, lintels and foundations require design
spec.loftWalls: Timber partitions only; spine stops below loft deck
changes: Move proposed cinema east wall to the midpoint of the loft bearing axes; extend its north and south returns, carpet, ceiling and acoustic lining.
Align the garage/service division and principal-suite bedroom/wardrobe division with that same line.
Keep a north return on the existing cinema-north/garage-store axis; it supports the remaining short loft girder.
Align the main openings in the three spine walls; move the cinema entrance south, keeping the existing sofa and at least 1.2 m beside it.
Move the basement west console to the north seating area; keep the accepted bar island and stools and at least 0.9 m on its west side.
Place walk-through wardrobe and ensuite in the west strip, with an open bedroom-to-wardrobe connection and a bathroom door.
Remove superseded principal-suite partitions and use its former dressing/bathroom area as part of the bedroom sitting area; retain the entrance from the landing.
Move the van west to fit the shallower garage; retain the existing external opening and all three vehicles.
Omit the south central loft girder and freestanding LP02 column in this alternative; retain engineered local trimmers at the entrance void.
Keep wall cores continuous through floor zones. Floors hang off them; upper masonry must not sit on joists or finishes.

limitations: A geometrically continuous wall is not a verified load path: design its openings, masonry strength/slenderness, restraint, padstones and raft reinforcement.
The west upper wall still needs a garage transfer. Reduced load does not make the currently drawn beam adequate.
The original-house retained walls and all exterior opening heads still need survey and design; this is not a whole-house structural solution.
The 245 mm solid timber trial is a gravity screen including a separate unshared 2 kN point case. Whole-floor vibration, support movement and fire/acoustic details remain unchecked.
The approximately 5.9 m garage bay may need 300 mm engineered joists; retain the existing floor outline and have the supplier check bath/partition loads. No solid timber approval is inferred there.
No finished ceiling heights or floor datums change in this study. Final joist/steel/hanger positions and service routes need the coordinated 3D rebuild.
Spine stops below loft decking. No brick/block walls are added within the loft. Original roof geometry and stairs remain.
